# 12 - CLI

Counted from the registries that define it. Run `pnpm census` after changing
a tool, a skill, a prompt, a role, a command or a guardrail;
`tests/docs/census-generated.test.mjs` compares this file against the live
registry, so a stale copy fails the build instead of misleading a reader.

## The commands (23)

Every command is listed with the arguments and options it reads, taken from
the commander definitions that parse them. The same definitions answer
`pix-galaxy-mcp <command> --help`, so nothing here is a promise the binary
does not keep.

`pix-galaxy-mcp` with no command starts the stdio server, which is how an
agent spawns it. `-h, --help` works on every command; `-v, --version` prints
the package version from anywhere. An error exits 1 and prints to stderr;
`--help` exits 0.

## pix-galaxy-mcp help

Show the full usage guide

```sh
pix-galaxy-mcp help
```

Takes no options beyond the global `-h, --help`.

## pix-galaxy-mcp serve

Start the MCP server (STDIO by default)

```sh
pix-galaxy-mcp serve
```

**Options**

| Flag                 | Default | Choices | Description                                                |
| -------------------- | ------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--transport <type>` | -       | -       | stdio (default), http (Streamable HTTP), or sse (HTTP+SSE) |
| `--port <number>`    | -       | -       | port for http/sse transport                                |
| `--ssl-cert <path>`  | -       | -       | TLS certificate (requires --ssl-key)                       |
| `--ssl-key <path>`   | -       | -       | TLS private key (auto-generates self-signed if missing)    |

## pix-galaxy-mcp up

Same as "serve --transport sse" (on-demand HTTP daemon)

```sh
pix-galaxy-mcp up
```

**Options**

| Flag              | Default | Choices | Description             |
| ----------------- | ------- | ------- | ----------------------- |
| `--port <number>` | -       | -       | port for the SSE server |

| `--skills`                   | -       | -                                            | install the bundled pix-* skills                                            |
| `--no-skills`                | -       | -                                            | skip the bundled skills                                                     |
| `--minimal`                  | -       | -                                            | minimal server tool surface (--no-minimal for full)                         |
| `--surface <spec>`           | -       | -                                            | server tool surface: minimal, standard, full, areas:<a,b> or skills:<s,...> |
| `--service`                  | -       | -                                            | register the platform daemon service                                        |
| `--no-service`               | -       | -                                            | skip the platform daemon service                                            |
| `--doctor`                   | -       | -                                            | run the health check at the end                                             |
| `--no-doctor`                | -       | -                                            | skip the health check                                                       |
| `--commands-preset <name>`   | -       | `minimal`, `standard`, `full`                | which commands to write: minimal, standard or full                          |
| `--commands-families <list>` | -       | -                                            | comma-separated: areas, personas, tasks                                     |
| `--commands-areas <list>`    | -       | -                                            | comma-separated area names, e.g. frontend,data                              |
| `--commands-skills <list>`   | -       | -                                            | comma-separated skill names                                                 |
